record.name: Shopify
record.one_liner: An ecommerce platform enabling merchants to build online stores and manage products, inventory, customers, and orders.
record.access_note: Developers sign up for a free developer account in the Dev Dashboard to create apps and obtain credentials.
record.api_note: GraphQL and REST Admin APIs read and writes products, customers, orders, inventory, and store data.

evidence.quote: GraphQL Admin API | Your app, on behalf of a merchant | OAuth, usually token exchange
The Dev Dashboard is where you create and manage apps, set up dev stores
Set up authentication for: - The GraphQL Admin API to read and write store data
We're excited to announce the release of the new Shopify.dev MCP Server!
